top_signals.title: Banana shipment from Ecuador to Europe concealed $290 million in cocaine
top_signals.summary:
Officials said traffickers hid nearly 1,700 pounds of cocaine among banana pallets inside a legitimate produce shipment moving through the international supply chain.

The post Banana shipment from Ecuador to Europe concealed $290 million in cocaine appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
